arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Credit' AND t.amount_usd_cents > 50000
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions over $500 made with credit cards, the same measure as the prepaid debit count.
assumptions: Credit cards means card_type = 'Credit' exactly, which excludes 'Debit' and 'Debit (Prepaid)'.
Over $500 means amount_usd_cents > 50000, as in the earlier query.
Counts all transactions, labelled or not, to match the earlier prepaid count.
Covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
